meta.name: ar-resume
meta.description: Resume a paused experiment. Checkout the experiment branch, read results history, continue iterating. Use when the user runs /ar:ar-resume or asks to pick up a previously started autoresearch experiment.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从上次暂停处继续实验迭代
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有中断的实验需要接着跑
copy.tagline_en: Resume an experiment from where it stopped and keep iterating
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to continue an experiment after a pause

howto.what: 当你要恢复一个暂停的实验时，Claude会先列出所有实验让你选择，然后自动切换到对应分支、读取历史记录汇总进度，最后问你下一步想怎么做。
howto.when: 当用户运行 /ar:ar-resume，或要求接续之前启动的自动研究实验时触发。

say.note: Claude 会切换到该分支并汇总进度

say.text: 接续上次中断的实验，继续优化延迟
say.note: Claude 读取历史并给出最近结果

say.text: 列出所有实验，我要选一个继续
say.note: Claude 显示各实验状态供你选择

howto.what_en: When you resume a paused experiment, Claude lists available experiments if none specified, checks out the experiment branch, reads the config, strategy, and results history, reports current progress, then asks how you'd like to continue.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /ar:ar-resume or ask to pick up a previously started autoresearch experiment.

say_en.note: Claude checks out that branch and summarizes progress.

say_en.text: Continue the last experiment and keep optimizing latency
say_en.note: Claude reads history and suggests next steps.

say_en.text: List all experiments, I'll pick one to resume
say_en.note: Claude shows each experiment's status for you to choose.
